title: Brownfield adoption promotion approval record
description: ADOPT-06 approval record: a human's promotion decision on proposed contract/golden/adr/relationship-authority/conflict/unknown items, bound to an exact (draft_hash, task_revision, git_ref) tuple so ANY change to the draft content, the task's CAS revision, or the git ref invalidates the approval. Deliberately a NEW, self-contained schema (D-11, no cross-file $ref) — NOT an extension of attestation.schema.json, whose constraints[] shape is a structurally different constraint-source binding vocabulary.

batch_id.description: Identifies the adoption batch this approval decides over.

draft_hash.description: SHA-256 of the draft content this approval was reviewed against; any draft change invalidates the approval.

task_revision.description: The task's CAS revision at approval time; any later revision invalidates the approval.

git_ref.description: The git commit the approval was reviewed against; any ref change invalidates the approval.

decisions.description: One decision per reviewed item; a promotion with zero decisions is meaningless.

approved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the human ratification.

decisionKindEnum.description: Exactly these 6 ADOPT-06 item kinds, no more, no fewer.

item_id.description: A stable id pointing back into the batch's plan.json proposal/question/relationshipCandidate.
